loc_dresser.desc: LOCATION (sunny cream clay bedroom dresser with a round mirror, a window behind showing sky-blue backdrop, cotton-wool clouds and a round warm-yellow clay Sun)

loc_star_cutaway.desc: LOCATION (a clay star cut open: glowing yellow and orange layers around a dull grey iron ball at its centre, on navy clay ground before a navy space backdrop with tiny cream stars)

loc_atom_bench.desc: LOCATION (cream clay workbench with a clay atom and a pile of sand and cream balls, a cream clay funnel on a wooden stand holding grey beads, sky-blue backdrop with clouds)

loc_scale.desc: LOCATION (wooden clay balance scale on grass-green ground: LEFT pan down and empty, RIGHT pan raised high holding a small green clay mountain with a cream snowy peak)

loc_space.desc: LOCATION (deep navy clay space with tiny cream clay stars and big swirling pale-blue and cream cotton-wool nebula clouds)

prop_ring_box.desc: PROP small signal-red clay ring box with a hinged lid and cream cushion (the only red thing in every scene)

prop_gold_ring.desc: PROP plain gold clay ring with a warm sheen

prop_neutron_star.desc: PROP small glowing pale-blue clay ball with a cream halo and two thin cream beams (a neutron star; repeat it for a second one)

prop_teaspoon.desc: PROP silver-grey clay teaspoon heaped with glowing pale-blue clay

prop_gold_beads.desc: PROP glittering round gold clay beads
